name: Juggernaut
description:
The blow lands and you feel the crunch of breaking bone through the handle of your weapon. You stagger back - that took a lot out of you - but it was worth it: your foe is reeling in pain. They will be easy to finish off in a moment, and the rest of them are giving you a wide berth, fear in their eyes. You catch your breath, strengthen your grip and raise your weapon again with a cry so fierce that you don't recognize it as your own at first. A last glimpse of the dread in your opponent's eyes and then that familiar crunch. You feel a spatter of blood on your face and you see stars from the effort. You balance yourself with one foot on their lifeless body and wipe the blood from your eyes as you breathe heavily. Your remaining opponents hold their weapons meekly, wondering who will be next. You're tired, but the battle's not over. You hoist your weapon to your shoulder once again and stride forward, fear before you.

A Juggernaut is an intimidating force on the battlefield. They wear the heaviest armor and wield the heaviest weapons. As if this grim gear of war were not enough, they are also trained to throw their entire weight behind each blow, making every strike a possible death blow, even if they must take a few moments afterward to recover themselves.

The Juggernaut mestiere uses Endurance as a resource. You start with more of it than anyone else and can spend it as you need to in order to deliver fierce blows. When your Endurance runs low, you can use your Hunker Down ability to take a breather and regain much of it. You're not especially mobile and the finesse of engagement is mostly outside your expertise, so you let your armor take the hits and respond with debilitating offense.

Every fight you are in is a boss fight, and you're the boss.

Play a Juggernaut if you want to:

  • Be a presence on the battlefield, a deadly and intimidating force who reshapes how the whole fight feels.

  • Land hits that end fights, throwing your back into huge swings that deliver life-ending force.

  • Absorb punishment and keep fighting, managing your Endurance as a resource to spend and recover across long, grinding exchanges.

Questions to consider when making a Juggernaut:

  • What do they fight for? Where and when did they discover their capacity for exceptional brutality? How do they carry the weight of the hurt they inflict?

  • How do they carry the literal weight of their gear? Is their heavy armor and the weaponry a burden they have made peace with, a source of identity, or something they barely register after years of wearing it?

  • Have they ever broken? Most fighters have a moment where they pushed past what they thought was their limit. What was theirs, and what did it cost them to find out where that limit actually was?

  • Do they frighten people—allies included? The kind of fighting a Juggernaut specializes in is not comfortable to be around. How do they relate to the effect their presence has on others?

  • They instill fear is so many others, but what do they themselves fear? What keeps them up at night?

novizio.description: You have extensive experience in combat with heavy armor and implements of war. You've learned how to land killing blows, and how to stomach the results.
novizio.gratuiti: A plume, banner or sash that makes your presence known on the battlefield. A book, small handicraft or other humble, private pursuit you use to center yourself outside of combat.
